tokenization_rule: Unicode-aware lexical tokens: [letters/numbers] sequences are words; an internal apostrophe or hyphen remains inside the same token; punctuation-only tokens are excluded. Contractions, possessives, hyphenated forms, and numeric forms such as 1900's count as one token. The same rule is used for sentences, marked spans, corrections, and gaps.

official_sentence_remeasurement.method: same token rule applied as a reconciliation pass against existing PDF-derived sentence counts
official_sentence_remeasurement.note: Official PDF text layer is not a reliable clean-token source; raw sentence text is intentionally not copied into this artifact.

span_type_definition.CLAUSE_OR_CLAUSE_LIKE: clause or clause-like unit identified with role/subtype/scope plus span length

correction_token_count_rule: max(source correction token count, target correction token count); no-correction claim=0; unparseable=null

measurement_confidence.span_word_count: high from visible underlines, with explicit transcription table
